items.title: Google Ads Search Insights Tool
items.summary: Google Ads has a search ads insights tool, also known as search insights, that shows you emerging and declining trends related to your topic or category. I don't think this is super new, as I found some Google Ads documents and blog posts on it recently but I have never covered it before.
